assessment: This important study provides a significant methodological advance for the study of Drosophila sleep, especially with regard to the study of its homeostatic features, as well as in its reevaluation of the 5-min rest period that is currently used to define the sleep state in Drosophila. Although time will tell whether the findings reported survive the test of time, this creative and imaginative piece of work provides solid strengths of evidence and food for thought, as well as important technical developments for the field.
